intro.text: Lady Stansi, an engineer who works with the Set.

items.text: Stansi joined the Set and came with her nephew, Lord Stanoux, to its Dulsing compound, built around a wrecked ship, to lead its engineers alongside Professor Javie and work out how the vessel moved. On Irich's tour she admired the woodwork, and he asked her to examine fittings that seemed to power the ship without electricity. She feared any one group holding such power, but Irich soothed her by appealing to her curiosity.
